subject: Site Engineer, Civil Utilities, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Site Engineer, Civil Utilities role in Adelaide, advertised on SEEK. The ad describes an engineer building capability alongside experienced teams on water, sewer and utilities packages.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day with inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, then field engineer on subdivision finishing works, tracking procurement and materials and keeping site, material and progress reports. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia, covering road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design to Australian Standards, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. My degree is a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019).

I have no water or sewer experience yet and I haven't used InEight, Aconex or Procore, so those would be new. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for site work, and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Glad to talk any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077

letter.subject: Application for Site Engineer, Civil Utilities
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Site Engineer, Civil Utilities role in Adelaide, advertised on SEEK. The ad describes an engineer supporting delivery on major water, sewer and utilities packages while building technical capability alongside experienced project teams, and that is where I want to go after eleven months on site and an Australian design diploma.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, passed on work priorities, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked the work against them, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to keep work moving. Site coordination, quality and safety monitoring, procurement tracking and site records are the parts of your role I have done; RFIs, variations, progress claims and environmental compliance would be new to me.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. Before that I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines in 2019.

Where I fall short of the ad: I have no water, sewer or utilities project experience, my site work was overseas, and I have not used InEight, Aconex or Procore. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for site work, and open to discussing relocation to Adelaide.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk about the project and what the site team needs.

checklist: Decide first whether you would move to Adelaide: the letter and email say "open to discussing relocation to Adelaide". If the answer is no, do not apply.

Open the McMahon Services careers board advert https://careers.mcmservices.com.au/jobs/site-engineer-civil-utilities-adelaide-sa-australia (the SEEK ad 94930149 links out to it) and press Apply; the board may ask you to create a candidate profile.

Attach the two PDFs from this record (resume and cover letter); answer the portal questions honestly (no utilities experience, Subclass 485 visa to December 2027, real availability, willingness to obtain project clearances).
Press Applied on the tracker with the date and "Company website".
notes: Large national contractor; early-career site engineer wording on a major SA water and sewer project. The "What you'll bring" list (utilities experience, InEight/Aconex/Procore) carries no essential marker, so those are disclosed as gaps rather than treated as a hold. Interstate: Adelaide relocation is Marc's call. Contact research (29 Sep 2026): the careers board shows the advert first posted 29 June 2026 and valid to 28 December 2026, so it is a long-running or re-posted vacancy; the project is not named by the employer anywhere (do not guess it in an interview). The leadership page names Mehdi Javanmard (EGM Civil and Infrastructure) and Michael Hyde (EGM Engineering and Projects) without emails; no published contact, portal only.
